item.title: Grassroots movement comprising thousands fuels disaster relief for Hong Kong fire victims
item.description: In solidarity with victims of the Hong Kong fire, a grassroots movement comprising thousands of volunteers have pitched in to provide relief.

item.title: Tiong Bahru Town Council adds iron net to outdoor courts after noise complaints, prevents pickleball play
item.description: Tiong Bahru Town Council installed metal netting to stop pickleball games at a void-deck court after residents were affected by noise.

item.title: BMTC debunks rumours that recruits are 'barred' from visiting McDonald's White Sands
item.description: BMTC says 'no restrictions imposed' in response to claims that recruits were told to avoid the McDonald's outlet at White Sands.

item.title: Jeffrey Siow seeks information regarding high-rise littering of glass & ceramic items at Choa Chu Kang
item.description: Acting Transport Minister Jeffrey Siow posted on Facebook seeking information on a case of high-rise littering in Choa Chu Kang.

item.title: Fire breaks out at Telok Blangah coffeeshop, 2 sent to hospital for smoke inhalation
item.description: Coffeeshop fire at Telok Blangah Heights forces 80 evacuations. 2 people were conveyed to hospital for smoke inhalation.

item.title: Tourist from China dies after falling from fourth floor of Osaka airport
item.description: A tourist from China died after falling from the fourth-floor at Kansai International Airport in Osaka, Japan.

item.title: Car travels along walkway at Choa Chu Kang, netizens wonder if driver was seeking rain shelter
item.description: A car was spotted driving along a sheltered walkway at Choa Chu Kang. Netizens wondered if the driver was seeking shelter from the rain.

item.title: Man in Taiwan smells unusual odour while driving, discovers dead body in the back of his van
item.description: A man in Hualien County, Taiwan, found the body of a stranger in the back seat of his van after he noticed an unusual odour while driving.

item.title: Restaurant caretaker in M’sia fined S$1.7K for selling contaminated fish head curry
item.description: A restaurant caretaker in Malaysia has been fined 5,500 ringgit (S$1,700) for selling contaminated fish head curry that was found to contain excessive levels of Coliform bacteria.

item.title: Hotpot restaurant staff in China mistakenly adds fuel to soup base, 11 people hospitalised
item.description: A waiter at a hotpot restaurant in China mistakenly added fuel to the soup base, leading to 11 people being hospitalised.
